notes: Access route: direct HTTP and Playwright both blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile; Claude-in-Chrome (real Chrome session) passed the challenge and was used throughout (see bs169.json notes for full access detail). Found two genuinely different New Arrivals listings, both site-labelled 'New Arrivals'. (1) https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/new-arrivals -- this is the canonical top-level category, also the exact URL the site's own HTML sitemap (sitemap.html) lists under the name 'New Arrivals'; breadcrumb 'Home / New Arrivals'; toolbar 'Items 1-36 of 3274'. Flagged for manual review: 3274 of the site's 4633 total catalog products (verified via /all-products, toolbar 'Items 1-36 of 4633') carry the 'New' flag on this page (~71% of the entire catalog), and the first page of items is in IDENTICAL order to /all-products' first page -- functionally close to 'entire catalog sorted by New' rather than a narrowly curated recent-arrivals boundary. Kept as a row (not discarded) because the site's own sitemap/taxonomy names this URL 'New Arrivals' as a genuine category, per brief guidance to record-and-flag rather than guess. (2) https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/deals/new-arrivals -- a second, meaningfully different listing nested under the 'Deals' section (breadcrumb 'Home / Deals / New Arrivals', reached from the homepage 'New Products' explore-tile which links to the top-level one, and separately discoverable at this /deals/ path); toolbar 'Items 1-36 of 610'. Confirmed genuinely different from both /new-arrivals and /deals (865 items): different item count and a different first-page product sequence than either. This is a plausibly curated subset (newest items that are also deal-eligible) and needs no ambiguity flag. Both rows kept per the multi-PLP rule (different product sets, different counts -> keep both, do not merge). No other New Arrivals-style URL (new-in, just-in, latest-arrivals, what's-new, new-this-season) exists in the sitemap or nav.
